description: Tests the ability of the user to navigate to the Privacy Policy page from the footer link and ensures the page content is accessible.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Locate and click on the 'Privacy Policy' footer link.
Verify that the user is redirected to https://roost.ai/privacy-policy.
Check if the Privacy Policy page loads correctly with all expected content visible.
expected_results: Privacy Policy page loads successfully with all content accessible.
edge_cases: Privacy Policy page URL is invalid or unreachable.
Footer link is not visible due to UI rendering issues.
User attempts navigation from an unsupported browser.
data_requirements: Valid URL for the Privacy Policy page.
dependencies: Privacy Policy page must be functional and accessible.
Footer links must be properly configured.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the Privacy Policy page.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the footer link is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Verify proper ARIA roles for the 'Privacy Policy' link.
Ensure readable font size and color contrast on the Privacy Policy page.
